notes.calls: Every *_ADDR environment variable is a service-to-service call.
notes.soft_calls: Reviewed in the source. checkoutservice/main.go PlaceOrder: errors from cart, catalog, currency, shipping and payment abort the order; a failed confirmation email is only logged (main.go:272-273). frontend/handlers.go: failed ads and recommendations are only logged. cartservice fails without Redis (RedisCartStore.cs).
notes.every_page: frontend/handlers.go homeHandler renders an error without currencies, products, the cart or a price conversion; checkout and shipping are only needed on the cart and checkout pages.
notes.integrity: Cart kept across the fault (same session) and a new checkout really produces an order (chaosmind/agents/integrity.py).
